description: This file defines the main game screen for a Tic Tac Toe mobile app built with Flutter. It includes the game logic, UI layout, and interaction handling, managing game state, rendering the game board, status messages, and reset functionality.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the Tic Tac Toe game screen, including game state management and UI layout.

classes.name: _GameScreenState
classes.description: State class managing game logic, state transitions, and rendering for GameScreen.

methods.name: _resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board and game state to start a new game.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks if there is a winner or the game is drawn, updating game state accordingly.

methods.name: _onTapCell
methods.description: Handles tap events on board cells, updates game state, and switches players.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns current game status message based on game state.

methods.name: _statusAccent
methods.description: Returns a color representing the current game status.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Determines if a cell is part of the winning line.
